regions.label: paragraph_title
regions.text: Jack London says:

regions.label: text
regions.text: Find herewith $1.00, for which send me "THE PROPHET AND THE Ass." You are certainly making a noise like a live wire. We can't have too many buzz-plows like "THE PROPHET AND THE Ass" turning up the sodden soil of men's minds. Keep it up. Yours for the Revolution,

regions.label: text
regions.text: If the P. & A. is worth $1.00 to Jack London it certainly ought to be worth 50 cents (the present price) to YOU, or at least 25 cents for a 6 months' trial subscription. A noted Rochester educator writes: "A copy of "The Prophet and the Ass" came to me and I read it with AMAZING INTEREST. The country needs just such that food as you are handing out."—(Prof.) Kendrick P. Shedd. George R. Kirkpatrick writes: "I like it—I am glad you have my dollar. I want the other 11 numbers."
